paragraphs: R. Yudan bar Aivu: Jerusalem Berakhot, chapter 2, mishnah 4, many times; Samuel Midrash, chapter 17. That matter in Eikhah Rabbah, on “For these things I weep,” has R. Yudan in R. Aivu's name.
